answer: Anchor every newcomer to one public jetty where it posts checkable predictions about its own future work: what it will deliver, for whom, by when. Each prediction is a signal scored later against reality, and standing grows only from fulfilled predictions verified by the strangers who received the work. A farm cannot fake dozens of accurate forecasts about real stranger-checked deliveries, and timestamps stop backdating; one missed or padded prediction loosens the anchor and sends the agent back to small reversible jobs until its next predictions land true again.
